# filtering out all specializing agents

```{julia}
final_epoch = maximum(st.epoch)

good_bees = unique(st.bee_id[(st.epoch .== final_epoch) .& (st.accuracies .>= 0.8)])

act_filtered = subset(act, :bee_id => ByRow(b -> !(b in good_bees)))

```

# statistics for suppression time distribution

```{julia}
act_win = subset(act_filtered, :epoch => ByRow(>(10)))
```

```{julia}
per_bee_task = combine(groupby(act_win, [:task_id, :bee_id]),
    :suppressed => (s -> sum(s)) => :suppressed_epochs,
    :suppressed => length => :n_epochs
)
per_bee_task.suppressed_frac = per_bee_task.suppressed_epochs ./ per_bee_task.n_epochs
```

```{julia}
task_summary = combine(groupby(per_bee_task, :task_id),
    :suppressed_epochs => mean => :epochs_mean,
    :suppressed_epochs => std  => :epochs_std,
    :suppressed_epochs => minimum => :epochs_min,
    :suppressed_epochs => median  => :epochs_median,
    :suppressed_epochs => maximum => :epochs_max,

    :suppressed_frac => mean => :frac_mean,
    :suppressed_frac => std  => :frac_std,
    :suppressed_frac => minimum => :frac_min,
    :suppressed_frac => median  => :frac_median,
    :suppressed_frac => maximum => :frac_max,
    :suppressed_frac => (x -> quantile(x, 0.25)) => :frac_q25,
    :suppressed_frac => (x -> quantile(x, 0.75)) => :frac_q75,
)
```

```{julia}

epoch = 0

st0 = subset(st,
    :epoch  => ByRow(==(epoch)),
    :bee_id => ByRow(in(remaining_bees)),
    #:task_id => ByRow(in(1:10))
)

# sanity: one row per (bee, task) at epoch 0
# nrow(st0) should be length(remaining_bees) * n_tasks
```

# global statistics for initial accuracy distribution

```{julia}
rmax = st0[argmax(st0.accuracies), :]
rmin = st0[argmin(st0.accuracies), :]

println("Global max @ epoch $epoch: bee=$(rmax.bee_id), task=$(rmax.task_id), acc=$(rmax.accuracies)")
println("Global min @ epoch $epoch: bee=$(rmin.bee_id), task=$(rmin.task_id), acc=$(rmin.accuracies)")
```

```{julia}
using DataFrames, Statistics

task_init_stats = combine(groupby(st0, :task_id),
    :accuracies => minimum => :acc0_min,
    :accuracies => maximum => :acc0_max,
)
task_init_stats.acc0_spread = task_init_stats.acc0_max .- task_init_stats.acc0_min
task_init_stats
```

```{julia}
max = maximum(task_init_stats.acc0_max)
task_init_stats[task_init_stats.acc0_max .== max, :]
```

```{julia}
max_spread = maximum(task_init_stats.acc0_spread)
task_init_stats[task_init_stats.acc0_spread .== max_spread, :]
```

# sum of rates

```{julia}
using DataFrames, Statistics

# stable sigmoid
sigma(x) = inv(1 + exp(-x))

function quantity_for_task(accs::AbstractVector{<:Real}, eta=1.0)
    h = maximum(accs)
    # exclude all entries equal to the maximum (handles ties)
    s = sum(a * sigma(eta*(a - h)) for a in accs if a != h)
    return h * s
end

# ---- compute for ALL tasks at a chosen epoch ----
epoch_sel = maximum(st.epoch)  # or set e.g. 10000
epoch_sel = minimum(st.epoch)  # or set e.g. 10000

st_e = subset(st, :epoch => ByRow(==(epoch_sel)))

q_by_task = combine(groupby(st_e, :task_id),
    :accuracies => (a -> quantity_for_task(a, 100.0)) => :Q
)

q_by_task
```
